mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, price, quantity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{quantity}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, oi.price, oi.quantity, (oi.price * oi.quantity) AS subtotal FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id
